name: QuickChatView: IntelliSense not working for file search in home view
description:
The IntelliSense/file search functionality is not working when creating a new chat (home view) in QuickChatView.

**Current Issue:**
- `@` mentions not triggering IntelliSense
- File search suggestions not appearing
- Home message creation lacks profile/file discovery

**Root Cause:**
- IntelliSense search requires `chatProject` context
- Home view may not have proper project context initialized
- Search controller not properly initialized

**Expected Behavior:**
- Typing `@filename` triggers file search
- Profile mentions work with `@profilename`
- Suggestions appear in dropdown
- Can select and add to message

# QuickChatView IntelliSense Issue

## Problem
IntelliSense (file/profile search) doesn't work in the home view when creating a new chat.

## Root Cause
- Home message creation may not have proper project context
- chatProject might be undefined when home view is active
- Search controller needs valid project state

## Solution
1. Ensure `chatProject` is always available in home view
2. Verify `selectedProject` is properly set
3. Initialize profiles before allowing IntelliSense
4. Test with home view flow

## Files to Modify
- `src/views/QuickChatView.vue` - Initialize project context for home view

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ IntelliSense works in home view
- ✅ File suggestions appear when typing @file
- ✅ Profile suggestions appear when typing @profile
- ✅ Selections properly added to message
- ✅ Works with selected project
